title: MarketplaceService
summary: Monetization APIs: prompt purchases and game passes (PromptPurchase/PromptGamePassPurchase), check ownership (UserOwnsGamePassAsync), and receipt processing for developer products (ProcessReceipt).

methods.name: PromptPurchase
methods.description: Shows the buy dialog for an asset (gear, t-shirt, etc.).

methods.name: PromptGamePassPurchase
methods.description: Shows the buy dialog for a game pass.

methods.name: PromptProductPurchase
methods.description: Shows the buy dialog for a developer product. Delivery happens via your ProcessReceipt callback.

methods.name: UserOwnsGamePassAsync
methods.description: Yields; checks game pass ownership. pcall it — can error transiently.

methods.name: GetProductInfo
methods.description: Metadata about an asset/product (name, price…). Yields; cache results.

methods.name: GetDeveloperProductsAsync
methods.description: Paged list of your developer products.

properties.name: ProcessReceipt
properties.description: ASSIGN (server) a callback receiving the purchase receipt; it must return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted after granting the item, or NotProcessedYet to retry later. Exactly one callback per server.

details.heading: Receipt flow
details.body: Developer products re-deliver receipts until your ProcessReceipt returns PurchaseGranted — including across servers and rejoins. Your handler must be idempotent: granting the same receipt twice would double-grant.

explanation.whatItIs: The shop counter: shows purchase dialogs, checks what players own, and hands you receipts so you can deliver what they paid for.
explanation.whyItExists: Real money changes hands — delivery must be reliable and tamper-proof, so Roblox brokers the transaction and re-delivers receipts until you confirm.
whenToUse: Game passes: check with UserOwnsGamePassAsync on join (VIP, 2x coins)
Developer products: PromptProductPurchase + ProcessReceipt for consumables (coins, boosts)
whenNotToUse: Faking purchases or trusting client claims of purchase — only ProcessReceipt on the server counts
Spamming prompts — show purchase UI only from deliberate player actions
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Client clicks "Buy 100 Coins"
  → PromptProductPurchase(player, productId)
  → Roblox shows dialog, processes Robux
  → SERVER: ProcessReceipt(receipt) fires
      grant the coins → return PurchaseGranted
      (if you fail → return NotProcessedYet; Roblox retries later)
```
tips: Cache UserOwnsGamePassAsync results per session; pcall + retry
Make ProcessReceipt idempotent: check before granting, never grant blindly twice
Store a 'pending grants' table if granting can fail, so retries complete them
commonMistakes: Assigning ProcessReceipt more than once (last assignment wins, silently)
Granting the product and returning NotProcessedYet — double delivery
Checking game pass ownership without pcall — transient errors break join logic
Client-side 'purchase complete' logic — delivery must be server-side receipt processing

examples.title: Idempotent ProcessReceipt
examples.code:
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local COINS_PRODUCT_ID = 000000000   -- your product id

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)
    if receiptInfo.ProductId ~= COINS_PRODUCT_ID then
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
    end

    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
    if not player then
        -- They left before delivery: Roblox will redeliver this receipt
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
    end

    local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
    if not coins then
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
    end

    coins.Value += 100   -- grant
    return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

-- Buying (LocalScript):
-- MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, COINS_PRODUCT_ID)
-- (from the server: prompt via a remote, since it needs a Player object)

examples.title: Game pass perks on join
examples.code:
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local VIP_PASS_ID = 000000000

local function applyPerks(player)
    local ok, ownsVip = pcall(function()
        return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, VIP_PASS_ID)
    end)
    if ok and ownsVip then
        player:SetAttribute("VIP", true)
        print(player.Name .. " is VIP")
    end
end
